inputs.name: assessResponse.input
inputs.description: Carries the response text and criteria used to select rubric checks. A blank or whitespace-only response bypasses evaluation and produces predefined results for those checks.

criteria.description: State the numeric result of the multiplication.

inputs.name: assessResponse.settings
inputs.description: Selects the model, confidence threshold, and environment variable used by credentialed evaluation. For blank responses these settings are bypassed and the empty-response path uses a fixed 0.85 confidence threshold.

inputs.name: assessResponse.evaluate
inputs.description: Optional evaluator that receives a JevRequest and resolves to a JevEvaluation. When supplied it replaces credentialed JEV evaluation; blank responses bypass evaluation.

inputs.name: responseStatus.checks
inputs.description: The assessments whose statuses are aggregated. Any violation takes precedence over needs-review, and an empty array yields satisfied.

examples.title: Fulfillment
examples.guidance: The response fulfills the requested task.

outputs.name: assessResponse
outputs.description: Resolves to the checks, aggregate status, evaluator model, and usage for a nonblank response. Blank responses skip evaluation and return checks, status, and usage without a model.

checks.title: Fulfillment
checks.guidance: The response fulfills the requested task.

outputs.name: responseStatus
outputs.description: The aggregate response-check status. It is violations if any check violates, needs-review if none violate and at least one needs review, and satisfied otherwise.

errors.name: Response evaluator configuration or request failure
errors.description: Thrown when a nonblank response uses credentialed evaluation and the selected environment variable is missing or whitespace; failures from the selected evaluator also propagate.
